title: Digital Garage Targets Japan’s Cash-Heavy Legacy Verticals
tags: Digital Garage Expands FinTech Suite with Integrated Digital Wallet for “Cloud Pay Business”Digital Garage and its subsidiary, DG Financial Technology (DGFT), have launched new digital wallet functionality integrated into their “Cloud Pay Business” DX solution. Developed in collaboration with group company Pocket Change, the platform aims to unify payments, loyalty programs, and customer management to drive digital transformation (DX) for brick-and-mortar retailers.Japan FinTech ObserverNorbert Gehrke
